title: Yummy Algerian Chicken Kebabs
description: Mustardy, chewy, high-protein kebabs cooked in a tandoor, perfect for a post-workout boost.
instructions: In a bowl, combine yogurt, mustard, yellow food coloring, cumin, paprika, garlic, salt, pepper, and olive oil to make a thick paste.
Add diced chicken pieces to the sauce, stir until fully coated, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour to marinate.
Preheat a tandoor or oven to 220°C (430°F) and line a grill rack with foil.
Thread marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving small gaps between pieces.
Brush the skewers lightly with remaining sauce to keep them moist during cooking.
Place the skewers on the grill rack and cook for 12–15 minutes, turning halfway, until chicken is cooked through and slightly charred.
Remove from heat, let rest 5 minutes, then serve hot with lemon wedges or a yogurt dip.
Pair with a side of roasted vegetables or a fresh salad for a balanced post-workout meal.
